name: Luke AFB
description: Home of the 56th Fighter Wing. Luke AFB is the Air Force's primary F-35 Lightning II and F-16 Fighting Falcon fighter training installation, training hundreds of pilots annually.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

currentNotifications.title: DFAC Temporary Closure – Remodeling
currentNotifications.body: Hensman Dining Facility is temporarily closed for Food 2.0 remodeling. T-Bolt Café (flight kitchen) remains operational for flight meals.

gates.name: South Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access point. After-hours visitor passes issued here.

gates.name: Lightning Gate
gates.notes: Primary visitor gate. Visitor Reception Center (VRC) located here.

gates.name: Lightning Gate Visitor Reception Center (VRC)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1600; Sat-Sun 0800-1300; closed holidays and base down days
gates.notes: Day passes, visitor registration, and DBIDS pass issuance. REAL ID required. Sponsor must accompany guests.
gates.address: Lightning Gate VRC, Luke AFB, AZ 85309

gates.name: South Gate Commercial Reception Center (CRC)
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle and contractor processing. Documentation required (bill of lading, work order, etc.).
gates.address: South Gate CRC, Luke AFB, AZ 85309

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Fighter Country Inn (623-935-2641) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (623-856-7841) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 56 FSS, M&FRC, and official Luke sites for in-processing and fighter training support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
